India vs Sri Lanka Test: Padikkal Century, Jurel Fifty Highlight Day 2

Day two of the first Test between India and Sri Lanka in Galle was significantly impacted by rain, causing delays. Devdutt Padikkal scored his maiden Test century, powering India's strong position. Dhruv Jurel contributed a vital fifty, stating he felt no pressure during his innings. KL Rahul retired hurt due to severe cramps. India reached 447-8 against Sri Lanka at stumps on the rain-affected day.
